section_insight:
999 duplicated lines across 30 clone groups (4.3% duplication ratio). Three high-priority extractions stand out.

**#1 — Chart card boilerplate: 5 components, 92 lines (group 26)**
BedtimePatternsCard, NapCalendar, NapTrackerCard, RecoveryReboundCard, and SleepConsistencyCard all contain identical 18–20 line blocks. Extract a shared `useChartDateRange()` hook or `ChartCard` wrapper to `src/components/charts/shared/`. Eliminates ~74 lines.

**#2 — LogsTable UI pattern: 3 tables, ~200 lines across 4 groups (7, 18, 21, 30)**
ChatLogsTable, RouteLogsTable, and SyncLogsTable are the top 3 hotspots (67 duplicate lines each, severity ~8.4). Groups 7, 18, 21, and 30 all fire across all three files — covering filter rows, column definitions, pagination controls, and empty states. These are the same table rendered with different columns. Extract a `LogsTable` base component to `src/app/(dashboard)/logs/LogsTable.tsx` parameterized by column config. Eliminates ~150 lines.

**#3 — DB query/upsert pattern across domain modules: cross-file, ~78 lines (groups 1, 5, 6+17)**
- Group 1: Identical 7-line block appears 4 times — recovery.ts (×1), sleep.ts (×2), strain.ts (×1). This is a query-with-fallback or date-range fetch pattern copied per data type. Extract `fetchDomainRows()` to `src/lib/db/shared.ts`. Eliminates ~21 lines.
- Group 5: devices.ts and integrations.ts share an exact 13-line block (100% similarity). Likely a soft-delete or owner-scoped query. Extract to `src/lib/db/shared.ts`. Eliminates ~13 lines.
- Groups 6+17: coach.ts and webhook.ts share 11–13 line blocks at 91–100% similarity across two separate patterns. webhook.ts also clones the same block 3 times internally (group 6 fires within webhook.ts itself — the highest-risk scenario for fix-one-miss-others). Extract the repeated webhook handler pattern into a helper in `src/lib/db/webhook.ts` and share the coach/webhook common query via `src/lib/db/shared.ts`. Eliminates ~37 lines.

**#4 — JWT/Apple auth signing logic: auth vs push, 40 lines (group 14)**
apple-web.ts (auth) and apns.ts (push notifications) share an 82% similar 18–22 line block — almost certainly JWT signing with Apple private keys. This is a high-risk clone: any key rotation or signing algorithm fix applied to one will be missed in the other. Extract `signAppleJWT()` to `src/lib/apple/jwt.ts`. Eliminates ~18 lines.

**#5 — HRVTrend vs TrendChart: same component twice, 57 duplicate lines each (groups 19, 20, 29)**
HRVTrend.tsx and TrendChart.tsx share three independent clone groups totaling 57 lines each (8+9+40 lines). The 40-line exact match (group 20) is the core chart rendering logic. These are likely the same Recharts wrapper with different data props. Merge into a single `TrendChart` parameterized by metric, or extract the shared render logic to `src/components/charts/useTrendChart.ts`. Eliminates ~49 lines.

**#6 — Test DB setup boilerplate: 6 test files, 66 lines (group 13)**
apple-web callback test, apple route test, coach test, scoped test, users test, and sync test all share a 9–16 line mock/setup block at 90% similarity. Extract to `src/test-utils/dbMocks.ts`. Eliminates ~55 lines. Low risk but high noise — every new test file will copy this again without a shared fixture.

**#7 — Internal clones in single files (highest fix-divergence risk)**
- `logs.ts` (group 3): exact 15-line duplicate at lines 80–94 and 196–210 within the same file. The two copies will drift immediately on any change. Refactor to a shared internal helper.
- `connection.ts` (group 9): exact 11-line block at lines 460–470 and 472–482 — adjacent blocks in the same file. Almost certainly copy-pasted retry/connection logic. Inline a local function.
- `upsert.ts` (group 15): 3 near-identical 13–14 line blocks (90% similarity). Upsert logic for 3 WHOOP data types. Extract `upsertWhoopRecord()` helper within the file.
- `sync.test.ts` (group 23): self-clone of 14–15 line test setup block. Use a shared `beforeEach` or test factory.

**Summary of highest-value extractions by lines saved:**
| Extraction | Target | Lines Eliminated |
|---|---|---|
| `LogsTable` base component | `src/app/(dashboard)/logs/LogsTable.tsx` | ~150 |
| Chart card shared hook/wrapper | `src/components/charts/shared/` | ~74 |
| DB shared query helpers | `src/lib/db/shared.ts` | ~71 |
| Test DB mock fixture | `src/test-utils/dbMocks.ts` | ~55 |
| TrendChart consolidation | `src/components/charts/TrendChart.tsx` | ~49 |
| Apple JWT signing | `src/lib/apple/jwt.ts` | ~18 |

The single most urgent fix is the internal self-clones (groups 3, 9, 15) — those are already diverging within a single file and will cause silent bugs on the next edit.
